changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM chat_permissions WHERE role IN ('ROLE_REFERENT_ACTIVITE', 'ROLE_REFERENT_SECTION')

ALTER TABLE user_role_names DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS user_role_names_v2_role_name_check

ALTER TABLE user_role_names ADD CONSTRAINT user_role_names_v2_role_name_check CHECK (role_name IN ( 'ROLE_USER', 'ROLE_SECRETAIRE', 'ROLE_BUREAU', 'ROLE_MEMBRECA', 'ROLE_ADMIN', 'ROLE_COMPTABLE', 'ROLE_ENCADRANT', 'ROLE_COMMUNICATION_SECTION', 'ROLE_COMMUNICATION_GLOBAL', 'ROLE_RESPONSABLE_BOUTIQUE'))
